nodes.biuro.text.t: The scribe lifts his head from the ledger so slowly the ledger has time to go out of date. "Jobs? Got them. Settlements? Got them. Patience? Ran out last quarter. What brings you, citizen: business or hopes?"

nodes.dowod.text.t: "Proof that you're alive? Lovely request. In this city there are fewer living people than papers confirming it. Try the House of Silence: Sister Jadwiga has a seal, and even the guards believe her seal. Or the barracks quartermaster, if you've got the forgery perk."

nodes.meld_stolica_dlug_splacony.text.t: "You paid it out of your own pocket? Man, that's not how it's done here." The scribe shakes his head in admiration. "But I'll log it as a charitable donation."

nodes.meld_stolica_dlug_umorzony.text.t: "She wrote it off? Her? That must have been one hell of an argument." The scribe raises an eyebrow. "One day I'll ask what you promised her."

nodes.meld_stolica_dlug_zastraszony.text.t: "You leaned on him? Effective. And cheaper than hiring a town councillor." The scribe stamps it without looking you in the eye.

nodes.meld_stolica_klucz_oddany.text.t: "Nipper got the key? He'll either burst into tears or rob someone out of sheer joy." The scribe stamps it with a faint smile.

nodes.meld_stolica_klucz_zatrzymany.text.t: "You kept the key? Nipper will find out anyway. That boy has ears all over town." The scribe closes the ledger.

nodes.meld_stolica_list_dostarczony.text.t: "Delivered it and didn't read it? That kind of restraint is the rarest virtue there is." The scribe stamps it with respect.

nodes.meld_stolica_list_przeczytany.text.t: "You read it? That's good, that's bad, that's... depends what was in it. Best you say nothing, just in case." The scribe rubs his hands as if he wanted to wash them.

nodes.meld_stolica_list_spalony.text.t: "You burned it? The marshal won't find out, and I won't find out that he won't find out. A beautiful arrangement." The scribe sighs with relief.

nodes.meld_stolica_nazwiska_spisane.text.t: "You wrote the names down? The city has its dead back. Who'd have thought that would be such a nuisance." The scribe signs without a word.

nodes.meld_stolica_nazwiska_sprzedane.te.t: "You sold the list? I like you, though I shouldn't. Just remember that whoever buys is rarely a good man." The scribe pushes the stamp toward you.

nodes.meld_stolica_nazwiska_zatajone.tex.t: "You kept quiet? Quiet, careful, sensible. A rare combination in these parts." The scribe closes the ledger.

nodes.meld_stolica_pozar_szantaz.text.t: "You made money on it? Respect. I'd have done the same, if I had a nicer coat." The scribe slides the receipt across to you.

nodes.meld_stolica_pozar_ukryty.text.t: "You let the kid go? Noble. And unwise, but noble gets written down faster." The scribe stamps it without enthusiasm.

nodes.meld_stolica_pozar_zgloszony.text.t: "You reported it? So justice had a good day. Wonder who scheduled that for her." The scribe jots down something he doesn't show you.

nodes.meld_stolica_przemyt_przejety.text.t: "You kept some of it? I won't ask for details. Honesty isn't this city's strong suit, so I understand." The scribe slides the chit over to you.

nodes.meld_stolica_przemyt_przepuszczony.t: "You let it through? Prudent. In this city not seeing things is a virtue." The scribe stamps it, looking at the ceiling.

nodes.meld_stolica_przemyt_zgloszony.tex.t: "You reported it? Civic-minded. Merciless. Wonder how many people will hate you for it." The scribe grins from ear to ear.

nodes.meld_stolica_skarbnik_polowa.text.t: "Half and half? Very human. Pity that here they count by receipts, not by humanity." The scribe smirks out of one side of his mouth.

nodes.meld_stolica_skarbnik_ukryty.text.t: "You hid the man? Well, the money is somewhere, so the books balance. I see no contradiction." The scribe stamps it and doesn't ask.

nodes.meld_stolica_skarbnik_wydany.text.t: "You handed him over? Rough business. But the money went back in the chest, and that's the kind of good news that pleases nobody." The scribe closes the ledger.

nodes.meld_stolica_wino_kupione.text.t: "You bought it honestly? Strange, but I'll write it down without comment." The scribe gives you a suspicious look.

nodes.meld_stolica_wino_nic.text.t: "You told them there'd be no wine? The marshal will be delighted. No, I'm joking: the marshal will hate you." The scribe sighs. "Oh well, at least it's something new."

nodes.meld_stolica_wino_przemyt.text.t: "Smuggled? Splendid. In this city everything good comes in sideways." The scribe brings the stamp down with a faint smile.

nodes.zlecenia.text.t: "The board hangs where it hangs. Anyone can take a job off it who can read, or pretends to. When it's done, you come to me, I stamp, somebody pays. In between nobody asks questions, because questions are expensive. Complaints I take on Tuesdays. We don't have Tuesdays here."
